description: This file is the main application component for a React-based gym management web app. It manages page navigation, user authentication state, and renders different pages/components based on user interaction.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component managing app state, navigation, and rendering pages.

methods.name: handleNavigate
methods.description: Handles page navigation, including access control for protected pages.

methods.name: handleSignIn
methods.description: Handles user sign-in, updates user state, and navigates to member home.

methods.name: handleSignUp
methods.description: Handles user registration, updates user state, and navigates to member home.

methods.name: handleSignOut
methods.description: Signs out the user, resets user state, and navigates to overview.

methods.name: renderPage
methods.description: Renders the current page component based on the currentPage state.
